jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager is the primary regulatory strategist and architect for our AI/ML Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) portfolio. While many companies view Regulatory Affairs as a purely administrative function, at Hinge Health we leverage this role as a technical discipline.

In this role, you will be responsible for the hands-on authorship and management of regulatory submissions (510(k), De Novo, Pre-Subs) for our cutting-edge AI products. You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, and Engineering teams to interpret the evolving FDA framework for AI/ML, helping us navigate complex pathways like Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP). You will also own the internal regulatory functions that support our Quality Management System, ensuring our rapid innovation remains compliant.



WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Submission Leadership (AI/ML SaMD): Lead the planning, authorship, and submission of regulatory filings (510(k), De Novo, Q-Submissions) for AI/ML-enabled software. You will be the primary author, not just a reviewer, translating complex technical and clinical data into compelling regulatory narratives.

 - Regulatory Strategy & AI Policy: Develop and execute regulatory strategies for new product introductions and major software updates. You will serve as the internal authority on the FDA’s evolving AI/ML Action Plan, guiding the business on how to validate and monitor adaptive algorithms.

 - Design Control & Change Impact: Participate in Design Reviews and Change Control Boards (CCB) to assess the regulatory impact of software changes. You will determine when a new 510(k) or "Letter to File" is required, specifically evaluating changes to AI models and retraining pipelines.

 - QMS & Internal Compliance: Support the maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring regulatory requirements (21 CFR 820, ISO 13485) are reflected in internal procedures. You will act as the Regulatory representative during internal and external audits (FDA, ISO).

 - Promotional Review: Review and approve labeling, marketing materials, and user manuals to ensure claims are substantiated and consistent with cleared indications for use.

 - Post-Market Surveillance & Vigilance: Partner with Quality to monitor post-market performance of AI models. You will lead the assessment of complaints for regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., eMDRs) and manage any necessary recalls or field actions.

 - Cross-Functional Coaching: Educate technical teams on regulatory principles, demystifying the submission process and helping engineers understand how their documentation directly supports regulatory clearance.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Software Engineering, Regulatory Science, or a related technical/scientific field.

 - Experience: A minimum of 4-6 + years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the medical device industry, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or Digital Health.

 - Submission Expertise: Proven track record of authoring and clearing US FDA Class II submissions (510(k) or De Novo). Experience interfacing directly with FDA reviewers during the review clock.

 - Technical Fluency: Ability to understand software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML concepts sufficiently to describe them to regulators. Familiarity with IEC 62304 and FDA Guidance on Software Validation.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - AI/ML Specifics: Direct experience with regulatory submissions involving Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Computer Vision. Familiarity with Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) principles and Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP).

 - International Experience: Experience with international registrations, particularly EU MDR (CE Marking) for software, or Health Canada requirements.

 - Data Analysis: Ability to review statistical analysis plans and clinical validation reports to ensure they meet regulatory expectations for substantial equivalence or safety/effectiveness.

 - Agile Integration: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment and adapting regulatory submission timelines to iterative software release cycles.


ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at  http://www.hingehealth.com/http://www.hingehealth.com

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager: Inbound
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hinge Health is seeking a highly skilled Supply Chain Program Manager to join the company's Logistics team.  As the Supply Chain Program Manager, Inbound, you will own the end-to-end inbound process for international products, partnering with vendors, our customs broker, logistics, and cross-functional hardware teams to keep inbound operations running smoothly.

This role is ideal for an experienced supply chain or operations program manager who enjoys solving practical problems, improving established processes, and seeing the direct impact of their work. You will manage vendor-facing programs, customs and duty workflows, commercial documentation, and invoice validation while helping Hinge Health deliver products to members on time.



WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH


IN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - Take ownership of the existing inbound process and establish clear operating rhythms, responsibilities, and escalation paths.

 - Build strong working relationships with international vendors, the customs broker, logistics partners, and Hardware Operations stakeholders.

 - Review inbound product flows, customs and duty requirements, HS-code usage, commercial documentation, and invoice-validation practices.

 - Identify the highest-impact process gaps and risks affecting product timing, cost, documentation quality, or vendor execution.

 - Establish regular reporting on inbound status, exceptions, documentation issues, and actions required to keep products moving.


IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

 - Manage the end-to-end inbound process for international products, from vendor coordination through customs clearance, receipt, and invoice validation.

 - Coordinate with vendors and the customs broker to resolve documentation, classification, duty, and clearance issues.

 - Ensure required commercial documents include accurate and relevant information, including appropriate HS codes and supporting details.

 - Validate invoices against agreed pricing, shipment information, and supporting documentation, escalating discrepancies to the appropriate stakeholders.

 - Partner with logistics and Hardware Operations to improve inbound handoffs, reduce avoidable delays, and maintain reliable product flow.

 - Track vendor performance and recurring operational issues, then drive practical corrective actions with internal and external partners.


IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

 - Enhance the scalability, consistency, and visibility of Hinge Health’s inbound operating process as product and vendor needs evolve.

 - Develop and maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and controls for inbound execution, customs and duties, and invoice validation.

 - Identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve vendor performance, and increase predictability across the inbound supply chain.

 - Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen supply chain operations and support new product or hardware programs.

 - Travel locally to vendors when needed to strengthen partnerships, understand operational constraints, and resolve issues at the source.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You are an experienced supply chain or operations program manager who can manage complex, vendor-facing processes from end to end.

 - You are comfortable working across international inbound operations, customs and duties, commercial documentation, and invoice validation.

 - You are a practical problem solver who can move between strategic process improvement and detailed day-to-day execution.

 - You build trust with vendors and internal partners, communicate clearly, and drive accountability without relying on formal authority.

 - You take ownership of outcomes, follow issues through to resolution, and use data and operating details to make sound decisions.

 - You are energized by visible impact and enjoy improving real-world systems rather than working only at a theoretical or reporting level.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or program management, including experience managing international inbound products and vendors.

 - Working knowledge of customs and duties processes, including the use of HS codes and supporting commercial documentation.

 - Experience managing cross-functional operational processes from vendor coordination through inbound receipt and invoice validation.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience supporting medical devices or other regulated products.

 - Familiarity with ISO 13485 or similar quality-management systems.

 - Experience negotiating vendor contracts or pricing, or implementing cost-reduction initiatives.

 - Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, such as NetSuite or similar tools.

 - Proficiency with Excel or similar tools for operational tracking, analysis, and reporting.

 - Familiarity with Linear or comparable project-management tools.

 - Mandarin fluency and experience communicating with vendors or teams in Asia.
   


SALARY RANGE

This position is [exempt/non-exempt status to be confirmed by TA / Total Rewards] and offers an annual salary, along with equity and benefits.

Please note that the salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors including qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

The annual salary range for this position is $116,00 to $159,500 + equity

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences, and costs to help people move beyond their pain.

If you are a strategic operator who thrives on solving complex problems and navigating ambiguity to build the future of healthcare, this is the role for you.

You'll work closely with our clinical team (the physical therapists, coaches, and care managers who work directly with members) to ensure marketing and clinical touchpoints work together to drive better member outcomes. You'll also partner with data science, creative, and product teams to design experiments, build personalized experiences, and measure what's working.

At Hinge Health, we're building AI into everything we do. In this role, you'll be on the forefront of AI in marketing, using AI tools to accelerate your work and partnering with our AI and product teams to develop smarter, more personalized member communications. We're looking for someone who is already using AI in their day-to-day and is excited to push it further.

 - Drive member engagement through lifecycle campaigns. Own strategy and experimentation to move key engagement metrics by designing multi-channel campaigns (email, SMS, push, direct mail) that get members to start their program, stay active, and come back when they disengage.

 - Work hand-in-hand with our clinical team. Collaborate with the physical therapists, coaches, and care managers who work directly with members to ensure marketing and clinical communications reinforce each other and drive better member outcomes.

 - Push the boundaries of AI in marketing. Partner with our AI and engineering teams to develop smarter, more personalized member communications. Use AI tools in your own work to move faster and think bigger.

 - Collaborate across the company. Work with data science, creative, engineering, product, and operations teams to get things done. You'll need to influence without authority and build strong partnerships to deliver on complex initiatives.

 - AI-forward: experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., AI-driven content generation, automated analysis, personalization platforms, LLMs) in your marketing work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be someone who actively adopts AI to work smarter and faster.

jobs.title: Associate Growth Marketing Manager, Direct Mail
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join Hinge Health’s Growth team and help improve one of our key acquisition channels: direct mail. In this role, you’ll plan and execute campaigns that help prospective members discover Hinge Health and take the next step toward better musculoskeletal health.

You’ll partner with the Direct Mail channel lead and teams across Growth Marketing Operations, Data Science, Creative, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Operations. You’ll own defined workstreams from planning through launch and measurement, using campaign performance, experimentation, and operational excellence to improve targeting, conversion, and return on investment.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Plan and execute direct mail campaigns: Manage audience selection, segmentation, mailer formats, messaging, timelines, and launch readiness for prospective member campaigns.

 - Manage campaign budgets: Track assigned budgets and forecasts in partnership with Finance, Accounting, and Procurement, ensuring spend is aligned with approved plans.

 - Optimize channel performance: Monitor volume, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, and return on investment, then turn performance insights into clear recommendations.

 - Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Bring together Creative, Copy, Data Science, Operations, and vendor partners to move campaigns from brief through production, quality assurance, launch, and analysis.

 - Support experimentation: Help design and execute tests across targeting, creative, messaging, format, and offers. Document results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

 - Create visibility: Maintain campaign calendars, briefs, documentation, and reporting so partners understand status, performance, risks, and next steps.

 - Communicate recommendations: Share regular performance updates and actionable insights with marketing partners and team leadership.

 - Build channel expertise: Stay current on direct mail, consumer behavior, and emerging acquisition technologies to help strengthen the channel over time.




WHO YOU ARE

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Associate Manager, Growth Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a QA Associate Manager to join our Growth Marketing Operations (GROMO) team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in marketing campaign testing and quality assurance, with expertise in audience segmentation, personalization logic, and campaign execution validation.

This role requires a deep working knowledge of marketing deployment platforms—including how to build, test, and troubleshoot campaigns using systems like Iterable, Adobe Journey Optimizer, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working within these platforms to design campaign logic, validate audience segmentation, resolve execution failures, and monitor post-send performance. You understand not just how to test campaigns, but how the underlying system logic impacts deliverability, targeting accuracy, and cross-channel orchestration.



The primary focus will be on testing, diagnosing, and optimizing marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging. You will work closely with marketing, CRM, and data teams to ensure flawless campaign execution and identify potential issues before launch.



As Hinge Health continues to scale its marketing complexity, this role will also help evolve QA toward more automated, AI-assisted, human-supervised ways of working. At the P3 level, that means using AI and automation to improve the speed, consistency, and depth of campaign validation, while applying strong judgment to verify outputs, investigate anomalies, and recommend practical process improvements. This role is not expected to set the company-wide AI QA strategy, but it should actively contribute to a more modern, scalable quality practice through thoughtful experimentation and day-to-day adoption of new tools.



WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH (aka Outcomes)

Testing & Validation

 - Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for marketing campaigns and audience segmentation logic.

 - Validate dynamic content, personalization rules, event triggers, and data accuracy before deployment.

 - Identify, document, and track issues related to segmentation mismatches, automation logic, and campaign execution failures.

 - Apply a mix of manual, exploratory, and repeatable validation methods based on campaign complexity, risk, and timeline.

 - Use AI-assisted workflows where appropriate to accelerate pre-launch checks, spot inconsistencies, and improve test coverage, while maintaining human review and final QA accountability



Diagnostics & Troubleshooting

 - Investigate live campaign issues using platform logs, segmentation reports, and campaign performance data.

 - Collaborate with marketing operations, CRM, and data teams to troubleshoot campaign execution errors.

 - Validate webhook integrations, API connections, and cross-channel marketing triggers, as needed.

 - Surface recurring failure patterns and recommend practical guardrails, checklists, or workflow changes that reduce repeat issues over time.



Data Analysis & Quality Assurance

 - Ensure audience segmentation accuracy and data integrity before deployment.

 - Use SQL or marketing analytics tools to verify segmentation logic and troubleshoot discrepancies.

 - Validate tracking parameters (UTMs, attribution tags) to ensure correct campaign performance reporting.



Process Improvement & Documentation

 - Develop QA checklists, testing procedures, and best practices for marketing campaign validation.

 - Document troubleshooting steps and campaign QA methodologies to improve team efficiency.

 - Provide recommendations to enhance workflow efficiency, audience segmentation, and testing approaches.

 - Monitor campaign quality signals after launch and use findings to improve future test strategies and defect prevention.

 - Partner with teammates to trial more automated or AI-supported approaches to campaign QA, anomaly detection, and data validation where they can reduce manual toil without compromising quality.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field of study.

 - 2+ years of experience in QA, marketing operations, or CRM platform testing.

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).

 - 2+ years of having a strong understanding of email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging campaigns.

 - Familiarity with segmentation logic, audience targeting, and personalization strategies.

 - Ability to analyze campaign performance data using Google Sheets, Looker, or Mode Analytics.

 - Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills, particularly in diagnosing segmentation and campaign execution issues.

 - Experience working cross functionally with marketing, CRM, and analytics teams.

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and automation, with the ability to use emerging tools thoughtfully to improve QA workflows while maintaining strong judgment and accountability for final outputs.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Basic SQL skills to analyze campaign data and investigate segmentation issues.

 - Experience using Postman, Retool, or similar API testing tools for troubleshooting integrations.

 - Familiarity with QA automation tools or scripting languages (Python or JavaScript) for efficiency improvements.

 - Understanding of direct mail QA processes and print vendor integrations.

 - Knowledge of email deliverability best practices, sender reputation management, and campaign performance monitoring.

 - Experience in fast-paced, agile marketing environments with rapid iteration cycles.

 - Experience experimenting with AI tools, prompt-based workflows, or automation assistants in a marketing, operations, or QA context.

 - Familiarity with human-in-the-loop QA approaches, where AI helps accelerate validation but humans remain responsible for judgment, escalation, and release readiness.

jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Growth Marketing Operations sits at the center of some of Hinge Health’s most complex, cross-functional workflows. As new implementations and associated processes scale, we need a Project Manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, stabilize execution, and turn reactive coordination into more durable ways of working.

This role is best suited for a systems-minded operator who can coordinate work across business and technical teams, design clearer operating models, and improve how work moves from intake through launch and ongoing support. You will help create the ownership structures, planning mechanisms, escalation paths, and visibility needed for complex marketing and operational programs to run more reliably.

You will partner closely with stakeholders across Growth, Data Science, Commercial Operations, Engineering, QA, and other teams to improve cross-functional execution, reduce manual coordination, and strengthen the workflows that support launch readiness and operational scale.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

 - In your first 3 months
   
   - Audit the current state of one or more complex marketing and operational workflows, including intake, handoffs, dependencies, approvals, decision points, and failure modes.
   
   - Build clear current-state process maps, identify where work gets stuck, and begin owning intake and traffic control so recurring work moves through a more reliable operating cadence.
   
   - Establish stronger visibility into in-flight work, including timelines, owners, risks, and critical dependencies across cross-functional stakeholders.
   
   - Identify where work is under-scoped, inconsistently tracked, or overly dependent on manual coordination, and recommend practical fixes.

 - In your first 6 months
   
   - Lead cross-functional coordination across partners such as Acquisition, Data Science, Commercial Operations, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.
   
   - Build and formalize intake models, ownership frameworks, escalation paths, and launch-readiness checkpoints for owned programs.
   
   - Create troubleshooting and triage workflows so issues are routed quickly to the right owners, exceptions are handled consistently, and recurring breakages inform process improvements.
   
   - Build the practical infrastructure that helps these workflows run better, including documentation, dashboards, alerts, status visibility, and automation-ready processes.
   
   - Translate ambiguous business needs and technical dependencies into clear project plans, milestones, handoffs, and decision points.
   
   - Manage budget operations for owned programs, including tracking spend, initiating purchase orders, reviewing and approving expenses, and maintaining accurate visibility into platform, vendor, contractor, and campaign-related costs with strong discretion and accuracy.

 - In your first year
   
   - Partner with stakeholders to determine which steps should be standardized, automated, reassigned, simplified, or stopped entirely.
   
   - Pilot improved ways of working, gather feedback, iterate quickly, and stabilize the new model until it can run as part of steady-state operations.
   
   - Improve operating quality by reducing avoidable coordination overhead, surfacing risks earlier, and strengthening accountability across handoffs.
   
   - Provide clear, data-informed program-level updates, surface risks early, and help stakeholders make thoughtful tradeoffs without losing momentum.

 - You have strong judgment about when to introduce process, when to simplify, and when to use automation or AI-enabled tooling to reduce manual coordination and improve visibility.

Join Hinge Health at a pivotal moment as we build a new strategic growth channel focused on healthcare provider partnerships. As Senior Manager, Provider Partnerships, you will create the strategy and operating model that enables providers to seamlessly refer patients to Hinge Health from within their existing clinical workflows.

You will serve as an entrepreneurial, commercially minded builder responsible for developing relationships with leading health systems, integrated delivery networks, academic medical centers, physician organizations, EMR vendors, and healthcare integration partners. This is a highly autonomous opportunity to build from zero to one, shape company strategy, and expand access to evidence-based musculoskeletal care.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH


IN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - Establish the provider partnerships strategy, market priorities, target partner profile, and operating rhythm.

 - Build a qualified pipeline across health systems, provider organizations, EMR vendors, interoperability platforms, and referral workflow partners.

 - Develop trusted relationships with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation.
